## Your settings
List the domains to watch, one per line, and how big a change should raise an alert.

## Fetch and compare
Gets this month's Similarweb estimates and compares each domain with its latest row. A failed run posts a short note instead.

## Save and alert
New months are appended to **History**. Domains past your thresholds go into one Slack message.

## Track AI chatbot referral traffic for competitor websites in Google Sheets
For marketers and SEO teams who want to see how much traffic ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude and Perplexity send to competitors, and when it changes.

### How it works
1. Every Monday **Your settings** sends your domain list to the **website-traffic** Actor on Apify, which reads each site's Similarweb estimate: monthly visits, the share referred by AI chatbots, and the split between ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity and others.
2. A Code node compares each domain with its latest row in the **History** tab. Similarweb publishes one month at a time, so a domain only gets a new row when a new month is out.
3. New rows are appended with today's date. If a chatbot's share moved by more than your threshold, or visits jumped or fell, one Slack message lists those domains. A failed Apify run posts a short note instead.

### Setup
1. Add your Apify API token as an *Apify API* credential.
2. Create a Google Sheet with an empty tab named **History** (columns are added on the first run). Paste the sheet ID into both Sheets nodes and pick your Google credential.
3. Pick your Slack credential and channel in both Slack nodes, then edit **Your settings**.

### Cost per run
$0.35 per 1,000 domains (traffic columns only). Ten domains cost under a cent a week. The node caps each run at $0.50.

**Apify node:** this uses the verified Apify node (`@apify/n8n-nodes-apify`). n8n Cloud installs it from the canvas; on self-hosted n8n add it under Settings > Community nodes.

### Customization tips
Change the thresholds in **Your settings**, or set `includeWebsiteChecks` to true for tech stack and email set-up columns ($0.70 per 1,000).
